strings.aNo: Makaseterata ke ene a dirang tshwetso. Go dirisa inFORMed ga go reye gore kgotlatshekelo e tla go naya taelo, kgotsa gore mapodisi a tla dira gore e latelwe.
strings.aS1: Isa foromo ya gago kwa go clerk wa kgotlatshekelo (modiri yo o thusang ka diforomo) kwa Magistrates' Court efe kapa efe, ka dinako tsa tiro tsa kgotlatshekelo (gantsi 9am go ya go 3:30pm ka malatsi a beke). Fa o le mo kotsing, o ka dira kopo le morago ga dinako tsa tiro. Ke mahala, mme ga o tlhoke ramolao.
strings.aS2: Clerk o leba foromo le wena. O e saena fa pele ga commissioner of oaths (motho yo o letleletsweng go go ikanisa gore se o se buang ke nnete).
strings.aS3: Makaseterata o e bala, gantsi ka lone letsatsi leo. Fa makaseterata a bona gore o tlhoka go sirelediwa jaanong, o go naya interim protection order (taelo ya tshireletso ya nakwana).
strings.aS4: Sheriff kgotsa mapodisi ba mo naya taelo eo ya nakwana. E go sireletsa go tloga fela fa a e amogela.
strings.aS5: O newa letsatsi la go boela kwa kgotlatshekelo (return date). Ka letsatsi leo lo ka tla ka bobedi kwa kgotlatshekelo, mme makaseterata o dira tshwetso ya gore a a go neye protection order (taelo ya tshireletso) ya bofelo. Tlhomamisa gore o ya kwa kgotlatshekelo ka letsatsi leo.
strings.aS6: Fa a sa latele taelo eo, bega kwa seteisheneng sa mapodisi se o se kwadileng mo foromong ya gago. A ka tshwarwa.
strings.aTitle: Go direga eng fa o sena go tlatsa foromo ya gago
strings.aboutG1: GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech) ke mokgatlho wa Aforika Borwa wa thekenoloji o o emelang ditshwanelo tsa basadi. O dirisa thekenoloji go ema batho ba ba fetileng mo tlhekefetsong e e amanang le bong nokeng. Gape o thusa batho go bona tshedimosetso, thuso le dilo tse ba di tlhokang ka ditshwanelo tsa bone, botsogo le go tshela sentle.
strings.aboutGLead: Tiro ya GRIT e ikaegile ka:
strings.aboutI1: inFORMed ke sedirisiwa sa GRIT sa AI se se thusang batho go itse gore ba dire eng ka tsa molao. Se bua jaaka motho wa mo motseng yo o kgathalelang ba bangwe. Ga se potlakise batho kgotsa go ba atlhola. Se thusa batho ba ba nang le tlhekefetso ya mo lapeng go tsenya se se ba diragaletseng mo kopong e kgotlatshekelo e ka e dirisang go tsaya kgato.
strings.aboutI2: Kaelo ya sone e tswa mo foromong ya semmuso ya kopo ya protection order (taelo ya kgotlatshekelo ya go go sireletsa), mo dikaeding tsa ditshwanelo tsa batho ba ba nang le tlhekefetso ya mo lapeng le tsa go kwala kopo e e nonofileng. Gape e tswa mo patlisisong ya MOSAIC ka se bomagistrate (baatlhodi ba kgotlatshekelo) ba se lebang le mo kaeding ya GRIT ya protection order.
strings.askDesc: Tlhaloganya ditaelo tsa tshireletso, se se diragalang kwa kgotlatshekelo le mafoko a molao.
strings.askOpening: Dumela, ke inFORMed. Ke chatbot ya AI, ga ke motho. Ga ke kgone go go naya kgakololo ya molao. Nka go tlhalosetsa gore di-protection order, ditaelo tsa kgotlatshekelo tsa go sireletsa batho, di dira jang, gore mafoko a molao a kaya eng le gore o ka lebelela eng kwa kgotlatshekelo. O ka rata go itse eng?
strings.bringA1: Buka kgotsa karata ya gago ya ID kgotsa phasepoto (kgotsa ID efe kapa efe e o nang le yona)
strings.bringA2: Kopo eno, mme Form 6A (dintlha tsa gago) e nne ka thoko
strings.bringA3: Sengwe le sengwe se o se itseng ka ene: leina la gagwe ka botlalo, nomoro ya ID, aterese ya kwa gae le ya kwa tirong, nomoro ya mogala, nomoro ya koloi, setshwantsho
strings.bringA4: Di-protection order tsa bogologolo, dinomoro tsa dikgetsi tsa sepodisi (CAS) kgotsa dinomoro tsa OB
strings.bringNote: O sa ntse o ka dira kopo le fa o se na dilo tse. Tla ka dikhopi mme o boloke tsa nnete mo lefelong le le sireletsegileng.

strings.fillOpening:
Dumela, ke inFORMed. Ke chatbot ya AI, ga ke motho. Ga ke kgone go go naya kgakololo ya molao.

strings.fillTitle: Nthuse go tlatsa foromo ya me
strings.footNote: inFORMed e go thusa go baakanya kopo ya gago ya protection order, e leng taelo ya kgotlatshekelo ya go go sireletsa. Ga se kgakololo ya molao, e bile ga e tseye sebaka sa mokwaledi wa kgotlatshekelo kgotsa ramolao.
strings.footPw: E dirwa ke GRIT · Gender Rights in Tech
strings.formEnglish: Foromo e tladiwa ka Seesemane, go ya kwa kgotlatshekelo.
strings.g1: Go baya batho ba ba fetileng mo tlhekefetsong kwa pele le go tlhaloganya botlhoko jo ba fetileng mo go jone. Tshireletsego le ditlhoko tsa bone di kwa pele mo thekenolojing le mo mananeong a GRIT.
strings.g2: Go dira mmogo le baagi ba metse, go akaretsa basadi ba bannye, batho ba ba fetileng mo tlhekefetsong le batho ba maitemogelo a bone a thusang go dira didirisiwa tseno.
strings.g3: Thuso ya dijithale e batho ba ka e fitlhelelang, go akaretsa Zuzi, sedirisiwa sa go tlotla se se dirisang AI mo appong ya GRIT, mmogo le thuso ka WhatsApp le didirisiwa tse dingwe tsa dijithale.
strings.g4: Ditsela tse di thusang batho go bona tshireletsego le thuso, go akaretsa dilo tse di mo appong ya GRIT tse di jaaka Panic Button le Evidence Vault.
strings.gen: Dira foromo ya Protection Order, taelo ya kgotlatshekelo ya go go sireletsa
strings.generalInfo: Tshedimosetso e e tlwaelegileng, e seng go tswa mo ditataisong tsa GRIT. Tsweetswee tlhomamisa le mokwaledi wa kgotlatshekelo.
strings.guideAudio: O amogetswe mo inFORMed, e e tswang kwa GRIT. Webosaete eno e go thusa go tlatsa foromo ya kgotlatshekelo ya taelo ya tshireletso. Ke mahala e bile ke ya poraefete. Go simolola, tobetsa konopo e kgolo e e pududu e e reng: Simolola foromo ya me. Go tswa foo o bolele kgang ya gago. Ga o tlhoke go kwala. Tobetsa maekerofounu e e pududu mme o bue, o bo o e tobetsa gape fa o feditse. Go tswa foo tobetsa Se reetse go utlwa se se tlhalogantsweng, mme o tobetse Romela fa se siame, kgotsa Se bue gape. Fa o bulela Bala ka lentswe, karabo nngwe le nngwe e tla go balelwa. Fa o le mo kotsing gone jaanong, letsetsa mapodisi mo go 1 0 1 1 1, kgotsa tobetsa konopo e khibidu ya go tswa ka bonako kwa godimo go tloga mo webosaeteng eno ka bonako.
strings.h1: Tlatsa foromo ya gago ya taelo ya tshireletso, ka thuso.
strings.hGbv: GBV Command Centre, diura di le 24
strings.hSadag: Mogala wa SADAG wa thuso fa o batla go ipolaya, diura di le 24

strings.hfIntro: Kopo ya gago ke eno, e balelwa kwa godimo. Ke se o tla se ikanelang kwa kgotlatshekelo. O ka tobetsa Emisa ka nako nngwe le nngwe. Fa sengwe se le phoso kgotsa se tlhaela, mpolelele mo motlotlong, kgotsa o se fetole mo foromong.
strings.howSub: Bomaseterata ba tlhoka dintlha tse di tlhamaletseng le tse di phepafetseng gore ba kgone go ntsha taelo ya tshireletso. inFORMed e go thusa go ba naya dintlha tseo, ntle le gore motlotlo o utlale jaaka go tlatsa foromo.
strings.iH2: Ke mang yo o ka bonang se o se kwalang
strings.iH3: Re e boloka lobaka lo lo kae
strings.iH5: Fa o dirisa founo le batho ba bangwe
strings.iP1: inFORMed ke chatbot ya AI e e dirilweng ke GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Ga se motho e bile ga se mmueledi, mme ga e neye kgakololo ya molao. E go thusa go baakanya foromo ya kgotlatshekelo ya semmuso pele o e saena. Clerk wa Magistrates' Court, e leng modiri wa kgotlatshekelo, o e leba le wena pele o e saena.
strings.iP2: Gore inFORMed e go arabe, e romela melaetsa ya gago kwa OpenAI, khampani e e nang le AI e e e dirisang. GRIT ga e bone kgotsa go boloka melaetsa ya gago. OpenAI e kopiwa gore e se ka ya e boloka, mme melaetsa eo ga e dirisiwe go ruta AI epe.
strings.iP3: Motlotlo ga o bolokwe gotlhelele: o a nyelela fa o tswala tsebe. Foromo ya gago e bolokwa mo founong eno fela, mo tsebeng e e butsweng, gore e se ka ya nyelela fa o bula tsebe gape. Fa o tlhopha “Boloka gore ke fetse moragonyana”, e notlelwa ka PIN e o e itlhophelang mme e nna mo founong eno go fitlha o e phimola. Ga go na ope yo o ka e bulang ntle le PIN, le e leng GRIT. PIN e e lebetsweng e ka se kgone go bonwa gape.
strings.iP4: Tobetsa Simolola gape kgotsa Tswa ka bonako go phimola se se mo tsebeng. Go phimola foromo e e bolokilweng, tobetsa “Tswelela ka kopo e e bolokilweng” mo tsebeng ya ntlha, tsenya PIN ya gago mme o tlhophe “E phimole”. Faele ya PDF kgotsa ya Word e o e daoneloutileng e nna mo difaeleng tse di daoneloutiweng mo founong ya gago go fitlha o e phimola.
strings.iP5: Motho yo mongwe yo o dirisang founo eno a ka bona mo hisitoring ya sebatli gore o etetse inFORMed, kgotsa a bona foromo e o e daoneloutileng. Fa seo se ka go baya mo kotsing, dirisa tab ya poraefete (incognito), phimola difaele tse o di daoneloutileng fa o sena go di dirisa, mme o phimole hisitori ya sebatli sa gago. Foromo e e bolokilweng ka PIN e nna e notletswe. Mo tab ya poraefete, foromo e e bolokilweng e a nyelela fa o tswala tab eo.
strings.iP6: Letsetsa mapodisi mo go 10111 kgotsa GBV Command Centre mo go 0800 428 428. Go di leletsa ka bobedi ke mahala. O ka dirisa le app ya GRIT, e e nang le konopo ya tshoganyetso e e go golaganyang le thuso.

strings.k1: O ka ikopela protection order (taelo ya kgotlatshekelo ya go go sireletsa) ka bowena, mahala, ntle le ramolao le ntle le go bula kgetsi kwa maphodiseng pele.
strings.k2: O dira kopo kwa Magistrates' Court kwa o nnang, o berekang kgotsa o ithutang teng; kwa motho yo mongwe a nnang kgotsa a berekang teng; kgotsa kwa tlhekefetso e diragetseng teng.
strings.k2s: Gantsi dikgotlatshekelo di bula ka 9am go fitlha ka 3:30pm ka malatsi a beke. Fa o le mo kotsing, o ka dira kopo le fa kgotlatshekelo e tswetse.
strings.k3: Tlhekefetso ya mo lapeng ga se fela go gobatsa mmele. E akaretsa go utlwisa motho botlhoko mo maikutlong, go mo sotla ka madi le go mo sotla ka tsa thobalano. Gape e akaretsa go tshwenya motho gangwe le gape, go mo tshosetsa le go leka go laola botshelo jwa gagwe.
strings.k4: Dinepe, makwalo a dingaka kgotsa batho ba ba boneng se se diragetseng ba ka thusa, mme o ka dira kopo le fa o se na tsone. Ngwana wa dingwaga dife kgotsa dife le ene a ka dira kopo.

strings.restoredPin: E buseditswe. Go tswelela o fetola khopi e o e bolokileng ka PIN, tlhopha “Boloka gore o fetse moragonyana” gape.
strings.s1d: Bolela se se diragetseng ka mafoko a gago le ka puo ya gago. inFORMed e botsa potso e le nngwe e e bonolo ka nako, mme o ka ema nako nngwe le nngwe fa o batla.
strings.s1t: Bua ka lebelo le le go siametseng
strings.s2d: Ntlha nngwe le nngwe e tsenngwa mo karolong e e tshwanetseng ya foromo ya kgotlatshekelo. E kwalwa ka tsela e bomagistrate (baatlhodi ba kgotlatshekelo) ba tlhokang go e bala ka yone: matlha, mafelo, se se builweng le kafa dilo di ntseng di nna maswe ka teng.
strings.s2t: Bona foromo ya gago e ntse e tlala
strings.s3d: Daonelouta foromo ya gago e e iseng e fele e le PDF kgotsa tokomane ya Word. E ise kwa go clerk of the court (modiri yo o thusang batho ka diforomo) kwa Magistrates' Court. O ka e leba le go fetola sengwe le sengwe pele.
strings.sBody: Kopo ya gago e tla lotlelwa ka PIN mme e bolokwe mo sedirisweng seno fela. Ga go ope yo o ka e bulang ntle le PIN, mme ga e ke e romelwa kwa GRIT. Motlotlo ka bowone ga o bolokiwe.
strings.sErrMatch: Di-PIN tse pedi ga di tshwane. Tsweetswee leka gape.
strings.sErrSave: Re maswabi, ga e a kgona go bolokwa mo sedirisiweng seno.
strings.sErrShort: Tsweetswee dirisa bonnye dinomoro kgotsa ditlhaka di le 6.
strings.sPin1: Tlhopha PIN (bonnye dinomoro kgotsa ditlhaka di le 6)
strings.sSmall: Fa o lebala PIN, kopo e e bolokilweng ga e ka ke ya bulwa. Tlhopha sengwe se motho yo o atamalaneng le wena a ka se kang a se fopholetsa.
strings.safety.death: Ke chatbot, mme seno se utlwala e le maemo a tshoganyetso a motho. Fa o na le nako ya go rulaganya gore o ka tswa jang mo kotsing, mpotse ka thulaganyo ya polokesego. Fa seno e le maemo a tshoganyetso mme o tlhoka thuso gone jaanong, letsetsa ambulense mo go 10177 kgotsa mapodisi mo go 10111. Dinomoro tse ke tsa mahala, ka jalo ga o tlhoke airtime. Gape o ka daonelouta app ya GRIT e e tla go golaganyang le thuso ka link eno: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele kgotsa iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.fallback: Ke maswabi, ke ne ke na le bothata jwa go araba gone jaanong. Fa o le mo kotsing, founela mapodisi mo go 10111, kgotsa GBV Command Centre mo go 0800 428 428 (mahala, diura di le 24). Tsweetswee leka go romela molaetsa wa gago gape.
strings.safety.goodbye: Fa o na le dipotso tse dingwe, tsweetswee boa o botse. Ke fano go go thusa nako nngwe le nngwe fa o tlhoka thuso. Sala sentle!
strings.safety.harm_other: O tshwanetse wa bo o utlwile botlhoko thata go ikutlwa jaana. Ke chatbot, ka jalo ga se ka metlha ke itseng go tlhaloganya maikutlo a batho. Setlhopha sa GRIT se itse sentle ka go thusa batho ka maikutlo a a thata le a a botlhoko. Tsweetswee ba romele molaetsa ka WhatsApp mo go 072 737 8819.
strings.safety.immediate_danger: Ke lenaneo la go tlotla, mme se o se buang se utlwala e le tshoganyetso e e tlhokang thuso ya motho. Fa o na le nako ya go rulaganya gore o ka tswa jang mo kotsing, mpotse ka leano la polokesego. Fa e le tshoganyetso mme o tlhoka thuso gone jaanong, founela ambulense mo go 10177 kgotsa mapodisi mo go 10111. Dinomoro tseno ke tsa mahala, ka jalo ga o tlhoke airtime. Gape o ka daonelouda app ya GRIT e e tla go golaganyang le thuso ka link eno: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele kgotsa iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.injured_now: Ke chatbot, mme seno se utlwala e le maemo a tshoganyetso a motho. Fa o na le nako ya go rulaganya gore o ka tswa jang mo kotsing, mpotse ka thulaganyo ya polokesego. Fa seno e le maemo a tshoganyetso mme o tlhoka thuso gone jaanong, letsetsa ambulense mo go 10177 kgotsa mapodisi mo go 10111. Dinomoro tse ke tsa mahala, ka jalo ga o tlhoke airtime.
strings.safety.rape: Ga go ope yo o tshwanelwang ke go feta mo go se o fetang mo go sone. Ga se molato wa gago. Nka go thusa jang?
strings.safety.suicidal: Ke utlwile botlhoko thata gore o ikutlwa o batla go ipolaya, mme ke itumelela thata gore o ikutlwile o ka bua ka seno. Ga ke motho, ka jalo nka se kgone go go tshegetsa ka tsela e e tlhaloganyang ka botlalo se o fetang mo go sona. Nomoro ya SADAG ke eno. Ga o tlhoke airtime go ba letsetsa, mme motho a ka go tshegetsa 24/7. Nomoro ya bona ke 0800 567 567. O ka leba le webosaete ya bona: https://www.sadag.org
strings.safety.support: Fa o tlhoka go bua le mongwe gone jaanong, GBV Command Centre ke ya mahala mme e buletswe diura di le 24: 0800 428 428. Gape o ka romela WhatsApp kwa go GRIT mo go 072 737 8819. Re ka ema go sekae nako nngwe le nngwe fa o tlhoka.
strings.safety.tracking: Ga ke neye ope tshedimosetso ya gago. Motlotlo wa rona ga o bolokiwe fa o sena go o tswala.

strings.wa.general: — Tshedimosetso ya kakaretso, e seng e e tswang mo dikaeding tsa GRIT. Tsweetswee tlhomamisa le tlelereke ya kgotlatshekelo.
strings.wa.help:
O ka kwala molaetsa kgotsa wa romela molaetsa wa lentswe ka nako nngwe le nngwe. Gape o ka romela:

{fill} go bona thuso ya go tlatsa kopo ya gago

{pdf} kgotsa {word} go e bona e le tokomane
{language} go fetola puo

Fa o le mo kotsing gone jaanong, letsetsa mapodise mo go 10111 kgotsa GBV Command Centre mo go 0800 428 428 (mahala, diura di le 24).
strings.wa.next:
Se o tshwanetseng go se dira jaanong:
1. Isa foromo eno kwa go clerk of the court (modiri wa kgotlatshekelo yo o thusang ka diforomo) kwa Magistrates’ Court efe kgotsa efe. Go dira kopo ke mahala, mme ga o tlhoke mmueledi. Fa o sa kgone go e printa, clerk a ka go thusa.
2. Tla le ID ya gago le sengwe le sengwe se se tshegetsang kgang ya gago, jaaka dinepe, melaetsa kgotsa direkoto tsa kalafi.{missing}{bring}

Tokomane eno jaanong e mo go WhatsApp ya gago mo founong eno. Fa motho yo mongwe a dirisa founo eno, e phumole mo motlotlong ono fa o sena go bona se o se tlhokang. Go phumola motlotlo ono mo go inFORMed, romela {delete}.
